text: Ana Lisa Sadovski I suspect it was a generic list of documents that they send to married couples applying to open a file for the first time, or a copy/paste error. There should be no need for you to provide an additional certificate unless you have been outside of Israel for more than 6 months consecutively since you first applied for the B1 visa. I would maybe try just sending the old one and noting that you already provided this when you started the process.
